As always, there are many uncertainties in the outlook, so let me turn, now, to a
discussion of some of the major risks to economic growth and inflation.

The housing risk is foremost in the minds of many homeowners and home
builders right now. Some observers have warned for some time that the housing market

was overheated. Over the past several years, there was a rapid increase in home prices
fueled partly by low mortgage rates. The increase in household wealth from home price

appreciation also helped sustain strong consumption growth in the current expansion.
